summary: This note is a Wikipedia-style biography of Karen Gillan, a Scottish actress, director, screenwriter and model born 28 November 1987. It covers her role as Amy Pond in the BBC One series Doctor Who (2010 to 2013) and her recognition for playing Nebula in Marvel Cinematic Universe films. It also mentions her role as Ruby Roundhouse in Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle (2017).
one_line: Karen Gillan is a Scottish actress known for Amy Pond in Doctor Who and Nebula in Marvel Cinematic Universe films.
key_facts: Karen Gillan was born on 28 November 1987.
Karen Gillan is a Scottish actress, director, screenwriter and model.
Karen Gillan played Amy Pond, companion to the Eleventh Doctor, in the BBC One science fiction series Doctor Who.
Karen Gillan's Doctor Who run is dated 2010 to 2013 in the note.
Karen Gillan has received wide recognition for portraying Nebula in the Marvel Cinematic Universe.
Karen Gillan played Nebula in Guardians of the Galaxy (2014).
Karen Gillan played Nebula in Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2 (2017).
Karen Gillan played Nebula in Avengers: Infinity War (2018).
Karen Gillan played Nebula in the untitled sequel to Avengers: Infinity War (2019).
Karen Gillan played Ruby Roundhouse in Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle (2017), described in the note as a box-office hit.
